SEARCH

All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
Button
A clickable button that displays text and runs a method when clicked.
CheckBox
A box with a text label that the user can check or uncheck.
Component
The parent class of every visual GooeyGUI component, such as Button, Label, and TextField.
Dropdown
A drop-down menu that lets the user choose one text option from a list.
FileChooser
A pop-up dialog that lets the user browse for a file to open or a location to save a file.
GooeyGUIException
The error GooeyGUI throws when a component is used incorrectly, such as giving a button a negative width or selecting an index that does not exist.
Image
A picture loaded from an image file (.png, .jpg, or .gif) and stretched to fit the component's width and height.
Label
A piece of text displayed in the window.
Panel
A rectangular container that holds other components.
RadioButton
A round option button with a text label.
RadioGroup
Links RadioButton objects together so that only one of them can be selected at a time.
Slider
A bar with a knob the user can drag to choose a whole number within a range.
TabbedPane
A container with a row of tabs across the top.
TextArea
A box for displaying or typing multiple lines of text.
TextField
A box where the user can type one line of text, such as a name or a number.
Window
The main window of a GooeyGUI program.
